purpose: Route every originally unresolved actor scope into an existing or explicitly deferred portfolio without inventing a named implementation owner.

scope_portfolios.remaining_boundary: Crate, binary and supplier/manual scopes remain separate. No coherent Streamer implementation writer is recorded; retain deferral and current SDK interface dependencies.

Tokio, Embassy and scheduler implementation ownership/custody is not established by the inspected metadata. Source9 retains its SDK/shared-interface portions; this does not assign a second SDK writer.
E2E part E6 and its runtime integration remain deferred. Shared SDK receive/builder duties can be recorded separately; no E2E engineering resumes.

The recorded existing XCDR2 implementation and derive need their own source/custody and coherent scope; native/Protobuf ownership does not include them. SDK references do not transfer XCDR2 implementation ownership.

Cortex-M and RISC-V providers require separately identified revisions and implementation custody; RTOS5 is not their owner merely because MCU targets are involved. Source9 owns only its SDK helper/interface portion.
Identify selected host/custom/non-RTOS backend and supported-configuration records. RTOS5 custody remains limited to its recorded MCU/RTOS scope.
Enumerate selected metadata/serialized wires beyond native/Protobuf; a generic wire duty does not select a new wire or authorize its engineering.
Enumerate actual classic UTransport/other binding implementations and revisions; iceoryx2/LoLa are subsets only when the duty applies. No new binding writer is inferred.
Select actual deployment graph, integrator and target/configuration/profile tuples. Deployment duties remain with the integrator, separate from supplier and binding duties.
Close the selected-part roster, including optional/external parts and suppliers. Known component routes do not constitute a complete roster.
